allow: PowerShell($env:Path = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('Path','Machine'\) + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('Path','User'\); "node $\(node --version\), git $\(git --version\)"; npx.cmd --yes skills add https://github.com/jburlison/wowaddonapiagents --skill wow-lua-api; "exit: $LASTEXITCODE")

PowerShell($env:Path = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('Path','Machine'\) + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('Path','User'\); npx.cmd --yes skills add https://github.com/jburlison/wowaddonapiagents --skill wow-addon-structure | Select-String -Pattern 'Installed|Selected|Risk|Safe|Low|High|Critical|error|symlink' ; "structure exit: $LASTEXITCODE"; npx.cmd --yes skills add https://github.com/jburlison/wowaddonapiagents --skill wow-api-widget | Select-String -Pattern 'Installed|Selected|Risk|Safe|Low|High|Critical|error|symlink'; "widget exit: $LASTEXITCODE")

PowerShell(foreach \($s in 'wow-lua-api','wow-addon-structure','wow-api-widget'\) { $a = ".agents\\skills\\$s"; $c = ".claude\\skills\\$s"; $l = Get-Item $c -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $files = Get-ChildItem $c -Recurse -File -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $scripts = $files | Where-Object { $_.Extension -match '^\\.\(ps1|sh|py|js|ts|cmd|bat|exe\)$' }; "$s | agents SKILL.md: $\(Test-Path "$a\\SKILL.md"\) | claude SKILL.md: $\(Test-Path "$c\\SKILL.md"\) | link: $\($l.LinkType\) | files: $\($files.Count\) | scripts: $\($scripts.Count\)"; \(Get-Content "$c\\SKILL.md" -TotalCount 5\) -join ' / ' }; "--- top level:"; Get-ChildItem -Force | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name)
